operation.name: GetNonGBVDashboardByLocation_ELRP
operation.query: SELECt StateName as StateName ,CountieName as CountyName ,PayamName as PayamName ,BomaName as BomaName , COUNT(NONgbvmainid) as GRsCounter from NonGBVMain_ELRP main inner join tm_States st on st.intstateid=main.StateID inner join tm_Counties county on county.intCountieid=main.CountyID inner join tm_Payams payam on payam.intPayamid=main.PayamID inner join tm_Bomas boma on boma.intBomasid=main.BomaID where main.Deleted=0 group by StateName,CountieName,PayamName,BomaName

operation.name: GetNonGBVDashboardByLocationResTimeAVG_ELRP
operation.query: SELECt StateName as StateName ,CountieName as CountyName ,PayamName as PayamName ,BomaName as BomaName ,AVG(DATEDIFF(day, main.Date,NGBVDetail.ClosingDate)) as GRsCounter from NonGBVMain_ELRP main inner join NonGBVDetails_ELRP NGBVDetail on NGBVDetail.NonGBVMainID=main.NonGBVMainID inner join tm_States st on st.intstateid=main.StateID inner join tm_Counties county on county.intCountieid=main.CountyID inner join tm_Payams payam on payam.intPayamid=main.PayamID inner join tm_Bomas boma on boma.intBomasid=main.BomaID where main.Deleted=0 and Status=5 and ClosingDate is not null group by StateName,CountieName,PayamName,BomaName
